I voluntarily authorize the company noted in the Electricity %%TERMS_AND_CONDITIONS%% to take all steps necessary to provide me with my product selection, up to and including obtaining necessary information from my utility company to begin or continue service. I also authorize the company or its representatives, if necessary, to contact me or an authorized representative of the enrolled account(s) at the contact information I provided to complete my enrollment, including by placing calls or texts to my cellular phone or landline using automatic telephone dialing technology and/or pre-recorded messages, and even if my phone number appears on any national or state "do not call" list.  I also acknowledge that my account documents, notices or other disclosures will be delivered electronically to the email address I provided, unless the company is required to send by mail or another format. If email does not work, the company will attempt to deliver account documents by mail. I agree to notify the company if my email address changes to ensure that my documents can be delivered. Continuous Service and Cancellation: I understand that this is a continuous service contract, and I will be charged monthly unless I cancel, the company cancels, or I switch to another supply provider.  To cancel with the company, I can call, email, or visit the company website.  Note: my utility controls the cancellation timeline, which means the company will continue to serve as my supplier, and charge me, until a final date set by my utility. In most states, this takes 1 to 2 billing cycles; in some states, the process only takes up to 10 days.
